base_wrapper.note: the flashable module scripts (module/, kmi.sh folded into lib.sh) are that release's, adapted here for the late-load stage: late-load.sh replaces post-fs-data.sh as the loader, emulated-soft-reboot.sh makes a soft reboot load too. Nothing is installed outside the module directory, and nothing has to be: the unload that an uninstall needs is uninstall.sh's job, because the soft reboot that applies an uninstall runs on_post_fs_data() (soft_reboot.rs:206) and prune_modules() lives there - it calls uninstall.sh and then deletes the directory. (An earlier revision of this note described a soft-reboot-unload.sh installed outside the module; that file does not exist any more.) The module id is the module's own (susfs_lkm_loader_lateload), not generated by the packer.

upstream_lkm.note: baseline for this branch: the official release v2.3.0-r18.4 (2026-10-20, tag commit 8b65f13f3e). It was merged onto our r18.3 delta as a three-way merge (ours = r18.3 + samsung delta, upstream = r18.4), so only three files needed hand resolution: kernel/Makefile (object list = union), kernel/sus_path.c (include block keeps both sides) and kernel/susfs_main.c (upstream rewritten file as the base, our layer-table extras re-inserted: rkp_branch layer, /proc/susfs_status node, susfs_fp_drain on teardown, up= bookkeeping). Adopted from upstream: ksu_allow_gate + control-node relabel (executed only below 6.4), the layer table with fatal/armed/fail_layer, imports_guard + crosscheck, the sus_path readlink face, the sus_dirent compat layout with the two compat getdents wrappers, opath fd-slot restore under files->file_lock, the sus_map outer show_map probe and the open_redirect fdinfo width fix. Four post-tag fixes from upstream main ride along: 7d74b9b9f6 (clear KPROBE_FLAG_DISABLED before reusing a probe), af563036db (__check_object_size guarded by CONFIG_HARDENED_USERCOPY), e1cc7ce5c3 (no ksu_file label without a KernelSU predicate) and a5e7ba57b8 (avc_spoof spoofs the tsid too, and refuses to arm when the sid lookup fails). Two fixes are ours: the branch site table went 16 -> 24 (14 kstat entry hooks + 5 opath hooks = 19 installation requests, old cap silently dropped at least two on RKP devices) and susfs_rkp_exit() keeps a site whose restore failed instead of decrementing the count and forgetting it. The variant string stays "GKI": upstream r18.4 switched it to "GKI-LKM" and FinaSU's ksud only classifies GKI/NON-GKI. The module scripts keep the matsu lineage, so upstream's set_description() (load result written back to module.prop) is not ported yet. Note on carriers: the older paragraph about all 14 entries failing described the sys_call_table route (commit 103cf9e, reverted). The carrier now is the function-entry fp hook, installed through susfs_rkp_branch_patch_callthru() on an RKP device, and sus_dirent's prefilter rides kstat_wrap_getdents64.

samsung_build.note: RKP-safe LSM kprobes + O_PATH kretprobes instead of text/rodata patching, Samsung KDP credential pair, issue #50 module-notifier fix, teardown drains, O_PATH flags-register fix

finasu_ksud_compat.why: the manager's ksud drives SUSFS entirely over the reboot supercall and refuses to write rules unless it classifies the implementation as compatible
finasu_ksud_compat.requires_feature_tokens: SUSFS_LKM_MODULES, and every other token must start with CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_
finasu_ksud_compat.note: a different upstream SUSFS version string makes ksud report unknown_protocol and refuse every rule - check this file after any upstream rebase

loader.note: built here rather than hash-pinned: the upstream loader at this baseline skips a kallsyms record that belongs to another module (c4e37af), which is the fix this branch wants. Its hash is recorded in the ZIP's provenance.json.
